queries.query: Bardhaman West Bengal official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Banglarbhumi
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Government of West Bengal Land and Land Reforms Department's Banglarbhumi portal, which lists Plot Info, Plot Map, Mouza Map and RS-LR land-record services. The Purba Bardhaman district administration separately lists District, Sub-Divisional and Block Land and Land Reforms offices. No open Bardhaman parcel API or safe downloadable parcel geometry was found.
